name: Enchant Weapon - Revelation
tooltip:
Enchant Weapon - Revelation
5 sec cast
Tools:
Runed Silver Rod
Reagents:
Soul Dust (8), Large Glimmering Shard (6), Greater Astral Essence (2), Cerulean Dye (4), Sulfuric Acid (4)
Permanently enchant a Melee Weapon to have a chance to trigger Revelation when a non-periodic spell fails to critically strike. Revelation grants 100% increased critical strike chance to the next non-periodic spell cast. Revelation's chance to trigger is diminished as your critical strike chance increases.
